spec.name: tap-uninstall-restores
spec.intent: Census @2f2a0238 (design and notebook at 2f2a0238); every path is repo-relative on the plan's line. A line number, count or observed behaviour cited here is a measurement at that commit: re-derive it if its path changed since. Add no new test file: a new one must be classified in packages/canon/test/gate-convicts.test.ts, which no unit of this plan owns; extend the test files named in outputs. Run one test file inside its package with `pnpm exec vitest run <file>` (a `pnpm --filter <pkg> test -- <file>` runs the whole suite). Sequenced after isolated-implementer and isolated-landing by the operator's ruling that the note 'implementers edit the main checkout' is realized first. Realize uninstall, removing from a host everything cratylus placed there and nothing the host placed, for the event tap on Claude Code (note 'event-tap cannot reach claude's act events', its last part). `cratylus eventTap install` in a directory with no .claude creates .claude/ and .claude/settings.json (packages/runtime/src/capabilities/event-tap/claude.ts:189-210), and `eventTap uninstall` (remove, :214-249) drops the tap's entries and writes back what is left, so the file stays holding {} and the directory stays. CHANGE. Uninstall removes a settings file that install created, and a .claude directory that install created, when nothing else is in it once the tap's entries are gone; a settings file or directory that existed before install keeps exactly what it held (the byte-for-byte case at test/event-tap.test.ts:157-178 still passes). Install and uninstall run as separate processes, as `status` and `read` already do, so what install created is known to uninstall without in-memory state. .changeset/tap-uninstall-restores.md: patch for @cratylus/runtime and cratylus.
accept: in packages/runtime, `pnpm exec vitest run test/event-tap.test.ts` exits 0, including a case: `install` then `uninstall` as separate dispatches with --settings at <dir>/.claude/settings.json where <dir> has no .claude leaves neither <dir>/.claude/settings.json nor <dir>/.claude; at 2f2a0238 the case fails (the file remains, holding {})
in the same run, a settings.json holding `{}` before install holds `{}` after uninstall, and a .claude directory holding another file before install still holds it after
in packages/runtime, `pnpm exec vitest run test/event-tap-harness.test.ts test/event-tap-skipped.test.ts` exits 0, and `pnpm --filter @cratylus/runtime typecheck` exits 0

missing: uninstall: 'which is left in place and reported' — eventTap uninstall reports nothing it leaves. In every case run its whole result is {"verb":"uninstall"}: a settings file install made but kept because the host since added a key, and a .claude directory install made but kept because the host since put a file in it, are left unnamed. Locus: eventTap uninstall's result (packages/runtime/src/capabilities/event-tap/dispatch.ts, case 'uninstall'; EventTapHostClaude.remove in packages/runtime/src/capabilities/event-tap/claude.ts returns nothing).

uninstall: 'nothing the host placed or changed itself' — a settings file that existed before install does not come back as the host had it. An empty file is left holding {} (cratylus residue). A file in the host's own layout (4-space indent, or one line) comes back rewritten in 2-space JSON, whether or not the host has hooks of its own in it. Locus: EventTapHostClaude.remove, the branches that rewrite a pre-existing file (packages/runtime/src/capabilities/event-tap/claude.ts).
